$comment: Rename to settings.json (project-shared) or settings.local.json (personal, gitignored). Hooks below are examples — uncomment to enable. See https://docs.claude.com/claude-code/hooks for the full schema.
$comment_validation: The format-on-save and secret-file-blocking hooks below are a recommendation, not a universal convention. If your project adopts a worktree-per-feature workflow, add SessionStart/WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks pointing at your own scripts — not included here since they're project-specific.

permissions.$comment: Pre-approve common safe commands so you stop seeing prompts.

env.$comment: Project-wide env hints for the AI. Real secrets go in appsettings.*.json / user-secrets / .env (gitignored), never here.

hooks.$comment_PostToolUse: Run after each Edit/Write — uncomment to auto-format C#/TS on save.
hooks.$comment_PreToolUse: Block edits to sensitive/secret files. Uncomment to enable.

PreToolUse.$comment: Example: refuse to edit local secrets or environment files.

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '(appsettings\.Local|appsettings\.Development|\.env(\..*)?)$' && { echo 'refuse: do not edit local secret/config files'; exit 2; } || exit 0

hooks.$comment_Stop: Run on session end — uncomment to print a summary or trigger CI.
